note: GROUNDWORK PLATFORM DEFAULT — applies to every tenant unless overridden per-tenant via /finance/config. Dollar/percentage thresholds that were previously hardcoded defaults inside engine code (flagged in docs/PUNCHLIST.md as 'numbers that are estimates'). Moving them here means tuning them is a config edit, not a code change, and any tenant with different thresholds sets its own without touching this platform-wide file. Every *_cents value is INTEGER cents, matching the DB convention throughout Finance OS.
